mkdir -p /srv/leakruns/b615c526bace-t1/ws/prep; cat > /srv/leakruns/b615c526bace-t1/ws/prep/build_dataset.py <<'EOF'
"""design_D97B 모델링 준비: tp 격자, 코호트, 특성, 결과 라벨, 분할 키 생성 (학습/평가 없음)."""
import json
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

WS = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DATA = WS / "data"
OUT = WS / "prep"
design = json.loads((WS / "design_D97B.json").read_text())

pat = pd.read_csv(DATA / "patients.csv.gz")
adm = pd.read_csv(DATA / "admissions.csv.gz", parse_dates=["admit_time", "discharge_time"])
labs = pd.read_csv(DATA / "labs.csv.gz", parse_dates=["collect_time", "report_time"])
proc = pd.read_csv(DATA / "procedures.csv.gz", parse_dates=["chart_date"])
H = pd.Timedelta(hours=1)

# --- tp 격자: 입원 후 offsets_h, 입원 중(tp < discharge)인 시점만 ---
tp = adm.merge(pd.DataFrame({"offset_h": design["tp"]["offsets_h"]}), how="cross")
tp["tp"] = tp.admit_time + tp.offset_h * H
tp["in_hospital"] = tp.tp < tp.discharge_time
tp["outcome_window_complete"] = tp.discharge_time >= tp.tp + 48 * H
tp = tp.merge(pat, on="patient_id", how="left")

cr = labs[labs.test == "creatinine"].sort_values("collect_time")
cr_by_adm = {k: g for k, g in cr.groupby("admission_id")}


def kdigo_flag(times, values, ref_times, ref_values, eval_mask):
    """eval_mask 행 중 하나라도 KDIGO(48h +0.3 또는 7일 최솟값 x1.5)를 만족하면 True."""
    all_t = np.concatenate([ref_times, times]); all_v = np.concatenate([ref_values, values])
    for t, v in zip(times[eval_mask], values[eval_mask]):
        prior48 = all_v[(all_t < t) & (all_t >= t - np.timedelta64(48, "h"))]
        prior7d = all_v[(all_t < t) & (all_t >= t - np.timedelta64(168, "h"))]
        if prior48.size and v >= prior48.min() + 0.3:
            return True
        if prior7d.size and v >= 1.5 * prior7d.min():
            return True
    return False


def known_aki(row):
    """exclusion aki_known_by_tp: admit~tp 사이 report_time 기준으로 tp에 이미 알 수 있는 AKI."""
    g = cr_by_adm.get(row.admission_id)
    if g is None:
        return False
    g = g[(g.report_time >= row.admit_time) & (g.report_time <= row.tp)]
    t = g.collect_time.values; v = g.value.values
    return kdigo_flag(t, v, t[:0], v[:0], np.ones(len(t), bool))


def outcome(row):
    """aki_48h: (tp, tp+48h] 채취 크레아티닌이 KDIGO 만족. 기준값은 tp-168h~tp 채취분 + 창 내 앞선 값."""
    g = cr_by_adm.get(row.admission_id)
    if g is None:
        return False
    ref = g[(g.collect_time >= row.tp - 168 * H) & (g.collect_time <= row.tp)]
    win = g[(g.collect_time > row.tp) & (g.collect_time <= row.tp + 48 * H)]
    if win.empty:
        return False
    return kdigo_flag(win.collect_time.values, win.value.values,
                      ref.collect_time.values, ref.value.values, np.ones(len(win), bool))


tp = tp[tp.in_hospital].copy()
tp["adult"] = tp.age >= 18
tp["aki_known_by_tp"] = tp.apply(known_aki, axis=1)
tp["n_cr_outcome_window"] = tp.apply(
    lambda r: 0 if r.admission_id not in cr_by_adm else int(
        ((cr_by_adm[r.admission_id].collect_time > r.tp)
         & (cr_by_adm[r.admission_id].collect_time <= r.tp + 48 * H)).sum()), axis=1)
tp["aki_48h"] = tp.apply(outcome, axis=1).astype(int)
cohort = tp[tp.adult & ~tp.aki_known_by_tp].copy()

# --- 특성 (report_time <= tp 기준) ---
def lab_feat(test, start_h, agg):
    l = labs[labs.test == test][["admission_id", "value", "report_time"]]
    m = cohort[["admission_id", "tp", "admit_time"]].reset_index().merge(l, on="admission_id")
    start = m.admit_time if start_h is None else m.tp - start_h * H
    m = m[(m.report_time >= start) & (m.report_time <= m.tp)].sort_values("report_time")
    gb = m.groupby("index").value
    return {"min": gb.min, "max": gb.max, "last": gb.last, "count": gb.size}[agg]()

for f in design["features"]:
    n = f["name"]
    if f["source"] == "labs":
        s = f["window"]["start"]
        start_h = None if s == "admit" else int(s.replace("tp-", "").replace("h", ""))
        cohort[n] = lab_feat(f["filter"]["test"][0], start_h, f["agg"])
        if f["agg"] == "count":
            cohort[n] = cohort[n].fillna(0).astype(int)
    elif f["source"] in ("patients", "admissions"):
        pass  # 이미 병합된 열(age, sex, unit)
    elif f["source"] == "procedures":
        # 설계대로(chart_date <= tp, 시작 없음)와 tp 시점에 확실히 끝난 날짜(chart_date < tp 날짜)만 둘 다 계산
        m = cohort[["admission_id", "tp"]].reset_index().merge(proc, on="admission_id")
        cohort["n_proc_as_designed"] = m[m.chart_date <= m.tp].groupby("index").size()
        cohort["n_proc_strict"] = m[m.chart_date < m.tp.dt.normalize()].groupby("index").size()
        for c in ("n_proc_as_designed", "n_proc_strict"):
            cohort[c] = cohort[c].fillna(0).astype(int)

cohort["sex"] = (cohort.sex == "M").astype(int)
cohort["unit_icu"] = (cohort.unit == "ICU").astype(int)

# --- 분할: family_id 결측은 patient_id로 대체한 그룹 (설계 수정 필요 사항, 보고서 참조) ---
cohort["split_group"] = cohort.family_id.fillna(cohort.patient_id)
rng = np.random.default_rng(design["split"]["seed"])
groups = np.array(sorted(cohort.split_group.unique()))
test_groups = set(rng.choice(groups, int(round(len(groups) * design["split"]["test_fraction"])), replace=False))
cohort["split"] = np.where(cohort.split_group.isin(test_groups), "test", "train")

cols = ["admission_id", "patient_id", "family_id", "split_group", "split", "offset_h", "tp", "unit",
        "outcome_window_complete", "n_cr_outcome_window", "aki_48h",
        "cr_min_adm", "sex", "hgb_min", "unit_icu", "cr_last", "age", "n_cr",
        "n_proc_as_designed", "n_proc_strict", "k_last", "bun_last", "cr_max_48h"]
cohort[cols].to_csv(OUT / "analysis_table.csv.gz", index=False)

# --- 요약 ---
summ = {
    "tp_rows_total": int(len(adm) * len(design["tp"]["offsets_h"])),
    "tp_rows_in_hospital": int(len(tp)),
    "excluded_aki_known_by_tp": int(tp.aki_known_by_tp.sum()),
    "cohort_rows": int(len(cohort)), "cohort_admissions": int(cohort.admission_id.nunique()),
    "cohort_patients": int(cohort.patient_id.nunique()),
    "family_id_missing_frac_patients": float(pat.family_id.isna().mean()),
    "outcome_window_incomplete_frac": float(1 - cohort.outcome_window_complete.mean()),
    "split_rows": cohort.split.value_counts().to_dict(),
    "missing_frac": cohort[["cr_min_adm", "hgb_min", "cr_last", "k_last", "bun_last", "cr_max_48h"]].isna().mean().round(4).to_dict(),
}
(OUT / "summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summ, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
print(json.dumps(summ, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=str))
